title: Choose the dashboard composition
question: The monochrome orange system is locked. Choose the structure to carry through the dashboard and administration experience; the selected structure will ship in both light and dark modes.

options.label: Readiness First
options.thesis: One dominant readiness surface makes the next operational action unmistakable.
options.viewport: The active event, readiness checklist, arrivals trend, and recent activity resolve in one glance.
options.risk: Best for one active event; switching context is intentionally secondary.

options.label: Live Operations
options.thesis: A live timeline leads, with status and follow-ups held in a compact side column.
options.viewport: The arrivals timeline, recent check-ins, communications, and staffing share a dark operational field.
options.risk: Optimized for live-event use; planning screens need a quieter light-mode counterpart.

options.label: Event Workspace
options.thesis: Events stay in view while the selected event opens into a complete operational workspace.
options.viewport: An event stack anchors a detailed readiness, check-in, communication, and activity surface.
options.risk: The denser master-detail frame gives individual charts less visual scale.
